title: Grateful Dead Live at Iowa State Fairgrounds on 1973-05-13
lineage: Reel > Apogee Mini ME 24/96> Apogee Mini DAC(monitoring)>Wavelab 5.0(dithered to 16/44)>CD>EAC>Minor Repairs on the GEMS Edit Station>Trac'ed Cdwave Flac'ed level 8 TLH

ai_review.summary: Mixed recording quality with Dolby‑processing complaints but a great 1973 soundboard show.
ai_review.review: The two reviewers agree the concert is a solid performance, calling it a "killer SBD" and praising the overall show. However, the audio processing is divisive – one reviewer notes excessive Dolby‑ization that ate the high end, while the other appreciates the cleaned‑up hiss‑free tape. The result is an enjoyable show hampered by contentious mastering choices.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised (≈4 stars) while recording quality receives mixed feedback (≈2.5–3 stars); weighted average yields ~3.7.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hiss removed but Dolby‑ization removes high end, making the sound overly processed; some listeners appreciate the cleaned‑up tape despite these issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers simply note it was a great show.
